description: Create many drafts at once from spreadsheet rows (up to 200): when, accounts (@handles), format, caption, first_comment, media (media library file names), series, title. Call with dry_run=true first: it checks every row like approval would (unknown handles, missing media, each network's limits) and creates nothing. Then call without it: rows with no errors become drafts and rows with errors are skipped and reported. submit=true sends the new drafts for approval. Nothing publishes until a person approves it in the app. An empty `when` takes each account's next free posting time.

dry_run.description: Check every row and create nothing

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

accounts.description: @handles from accounts_list, comma-separated. A handle on two networks gets both; write instagram:@handle (or tiktok:, threads:, youtube:, facebook:) for just one.

first_comment.description: Instagram: posted as the first comment.

format.description: reel, trial reel, photo, carousel, video, story or text. Empty: from the media (one video is a Reel or video, one photo a Photo, several a Carousel, none Text where the network takes it).

media.description: File names (or ids) from media_list, comma-separated, in order. Links are never fetched: add files with media_import_url first.

series.description: A series name from series_list; the post becomes its next episode.

title.description: Internal name. Defaults to the caption's start.

when.description: Date and time in the workspace's timezone: 2026-11-03 18:30, 2026-11-03 6:30 PM or 11/3/2026 6:30 PM (ISO 8601 with an offset also works). A date alone takes that day's free posting time. Empty: each account's next free posting time.

submit.description: Send the new drafts for approval

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: posts_import
title: Import drafts from a spreadsheet
